For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

cannot be adjusted or discounted

FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Description:
Add a unique piece of history to your space with this assortment of vintage teal glass insulators, once used to support overhead power lines. Each insulator in this set showcases distinct shapes, textures, and slightly different shades of teal and green, creating a captivating collection for display. Visible wear and patina reflect their authentic utility and age, enhancing their nostalgic character and appeal. One notable feature is a wooden base with a descriptive label, indicating these insulators were part of the Colorado Springs - Cripple Creek Toll Line, dated from 1910 to 1978. This historical detail adds an extra layer of interest, making the set especially attractive for collectors and history enthusiasts. Ideal for use as decorative accents on shelves, mantels, or desks, these insulators offer a charming way to incorporate industrial heritage into your home or office decor. This item is in used vintage condition and displays signs of wear consistent with age and previous use

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Carved Briar Tobacco Pipe
Bent Smoking Pipe With Red Swirl Stem
Briar Wood & Acrylic, Approximately 5 Inches
This vintage estate tobacco smoking pipe features a carved briar bowl in a rounded bent apple profile with a rich reddish-brown finish. Fitted with a silver-tone metal shank band and a curved mouthpiece in marbled red acrylic, it exemplifies mid-to-late 20th century pipe craftsmanship. Carved briar pipes are valued by enthusiasts for their tactile grip and heat dissipation.
Hand-carved scroll and channel texture across the rounded briar bowl
Bent ruby red swirl acrylic stem with silver-tone metal accent band
Stamped numbers 048 and 18 on shank near the band
Measures approximately 5 inches in overall length with a 1.9-inch bowl height
Condition:
Previously smoked estate condition. Bowl shows normal carbon cake and rim char from use. Exterior briar carving remains intact with minor surface handling wear. Stem is secure with minor tooth chatter near the lip. Metal collar is firmly seated.

Orders will ship via USPS, or FedEx services. Items may be marked as being shipped USPS but may come via FedEx and vice versa. If you want your item to be shipped a certain carrier please inform before paying for the item.
Any additional shipping instructions requested (I.E. individually wrapping items, duplicate boxes, etc) will require additional shipping charges to be paid by the customer. We will work with customers to fit their requests at the lowest possible shipping charge. Any order that totals equal to or greater than $120 will automatically require an indirect signature upon delivery. Any order that totals equal to or greater than $400 will automatically require an direct signature upon delivery. If you choose to negate this process you claim full responsibility for the delivery of the item as we provide the tracking information to you.
In the event a large item is won that is marked for local pickup only, you the buyer will have the option to have the item pick it up by a freight company at your expense.
Please note that all items ship in the order they are received and will ship within 5 business days (Excluding weekends and holidays) of the payment date.

description:
Mixed Rocks Minerals Fossils Collection Quartz Bismuth Petrified Wood Lot
This lot contains a mixed assortment of rocks, minerals, and fossils in a clear resealable bag. Included are quartz, bismuth crystals, petrified wood, and other unidentified mineral specimens. The pieces vary in color, size, and texture, featuring natural crystal formations and raw, unpolished rocks. Items show signs of handling and age, reflecting natural sourcing. Suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or enthusiasts seeking a diverse sample set.
Details
For lotted Items please note that items may be damaged/missing parts/pieces/uncomplete set same with "Open Box" may not contain the complete set.
Items are NOT tested for longevity or functionality. May still require repairs or new replacement parts. (Applies to items stated to power on/tested)
This item is in used condition. There MAY be some scuffs, scratches, stains/discoloration and scrapes consistent with previous ownership. Items may have damages seen in the photos and MAY NOT always be noted in our descriptions or vice versa. PLEASE LOOK AT PHOTOS, TITLE, DESCRIPTION AND DISCLAIMERS BEFORE BIDDING.
NIB/NIP = New In Box/Package, IOB = In Original Box, NWT = New With Tags
DISCLAIMER
Items available up for auction are used, donated, previously owned, and are sold on a FINAL SALE and AS-IS basis without complete functionality/longevity testing. All items may exhibit minor scratches or scuffs, which MAY NOT be evident in photos. Severe damage will be documented in photos or descriptions when possible as accurately as we can. Prospective bidders should carefully review photos, title, description, disclaimers and ASK QUESTIONS PRIOR TO BIDDING, noting that bid retractions are NOT ALWAYS permitted. A new system is being used and may not always accurately describe the item, we are doing our best to ensure the corrected details are being added, but may still get overlooked. Please send us a ticket if you have any question regarding the item.
Measurements provided are approximate aims to indicate size/weight, and color representation may differ from in person with different lighting. Additionally, multi-disc media/ANY item that is a set may be incomplete, and buyers should verify state laws regarding the sale and purchase of gun magazines, which can vary. Silver/gold tone listed items have no actual fine sterling or solid gold/plated items in the lots and are mainly fashion/costume jewelry. If an item is AUTHENTICATED, it is by LegitMark and will have a COA, or CERTIFICATE OF AUTHENTICITY
Our employees at HOT Goodwill Ecommerce use their knowledge, research skills, and Google Lens to provide most answers in the listing. While observations/efforts are made to accurately describe items, we DO NOT CLAIM EXPERTISE on any given field and may overlook details. If you have any questions about information not provided by our photos or our descriptions or item/seller/shipping tabs, please SUBMIT A CUSTOMER SERVICE TICKET and we will be happy to assist you.

title: Cross 1/20 12KT Gold Filled Ballpoint Pen & Pencil Set Classic Century Vintage
description:
Cross
Classic Century Ballpoint Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set
1/20 12KT Gold Filled, Vintage with Original Box
The Cross Classic Century collection is a hallmark of American industrial design, celebrated for its slender silhouette and iconic conical top. Introduced to commemorate the company's centennial, this 12-karat gold-filled set represents the pinnacle of mid-20th-century professional writing instruments, combining a refined aesthetic with durable mechanical reliability.
1/20 12KT Gold Filled finish with linear pinstripe engraving on barrels
Twist-action mechanisms for ballpoint ink and mechanical lead advancement
Personalized engraving "DAVID #1" on upper barrel of both instruments
Complete with original presentation box and operating instructions booklet
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Both pieces are personalized with "DAVID #1" near the clip. Gold-filled surfaces show light micro-scratching and minor age-appropriate patina. Mechanical components function smoothly as intended. The original presentation case is intact with minor external shelf wear and a clean green velvet-style interior.
Thank you for shopping Goodwill Southern California, and for supporting our mission to provide jobs for individuals with disabilities and disadvantages. Your purchases help create jobs, hopes, and futures.

Natural Quartz Geode Specimens
Lot of 3 Raw Crystal Geode Pieces
Natural Mineral Rock Specimens
This collection features three natural quartz geode specimens showcasing sparkling crystalline interiors within rugged outer rinds. The lot includes one substantial nodule with an open crystallized cavity alongside two matching hollow halves of a split geode. These geological specimens highlight authentic druzy crystal formations and earthy matrix tones, making them ideal for mineral displays, educational study, or lapidary collections.
Three total pieces: one large geode nodule with cavity and two split geode halves
Natural crystalline interiors displaying translucent to white quartz crystal points and druzy texture
Rugged, unpolished natural stone exterior rinds showing earthy tan and brown mineral coloration
Combined lot weight of approximately 4.85 pounds; packaged dimensions measure approximately 11 x 5.5 x 5 inches

description:
Large Rock Mineral Collection Bundle Good and Beautiful Educational Box
This large rock and mineral collection bundle includes the Good and Beautiful branded educational specimen box with 9 labeled compartments featuring igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic, and mineral samples such as mica, quartz, and pyrite. description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

Natural Stone, Approximately 4 Inches, 1.0 lb
Natural cut and polished agate geode half showcasing concentric chalcedony banding surrounding an interior crystal druzy pocket. The outer rind features natural textured volcanic rock matrix, while the cut surface is smoothly polished to highlight the delicate grey, white, and translucent agate rings. Polished face revealing concentric banded agate and chalcedony rings
Center hollow cavity lined with dark crystalline quartz druzy points

Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
